tools.name: agent__cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running agent. The child exits at its next yield point.

tools.name: agent__list
tools.description: List agents in caller's spawn tree. Returns [{id, session_id, status, model, started_at, last_turn_at, cost_so_far_usd}].

tools.name: agent__read_messages
tools.description: Read assistant-role messages from an agent's output channel. Optional since/timeout for incremental polling. Returns {messages, offset, status}.

tools.name: agent__send_message
tools.description: Send a user-role message into an agent's inbox. Delivered at the agent's next yield point.

tools.name: agent__spawn
tools.description: Spawn an attenuated sub-agent, optionally from an immutable historical session point. Returns {id, session_id, status, final_text?}. execution=retained creates an addressable child; async controls whether this call waits. Model and persona inherit by default.
